name: Asphalt_Patch
blurb: 1.8 x 1.1 m patch, 1.2 cm thick. Visual only. Place it on a road top (y = 0.12).
climbNote: Decal. The road slab under it is the collider.
vaultNote: No collider of its own, so it cannot become a lip.

name: Barrier
blurb: Jersey barrier 3.0 m long, 0.60 m at the base, 0.82 m tall, tapered.
climbNote: Too low and sloped to cling.
vaultNote: Top is 0.82 m, under the 0.90 m vault band.

name: Bench_Wood
blurb: 1.80 m park bench. Each end is one dark-green cast profile with a wood arm seated on it. Seat and back slats overhang the iron by about 6 cm. Seat at 0.45 m.
climbNote: Back slats are too broken up to cling. Not a wall-run panel.
vaultNote: Seat is 0.45 m. Below the 0.90–1.05 m vault band.

name: BikeRack
blurb: Three inverted-U hoops. 0.85 m tall, 1.90 m overall, tube 4 cm.
climbNote: Tubes are too thin to cling.
vaultNote: Hoop tops are 0.85 m, just under the vault band, and round.

name: Boat
blurb: Work boat, 6.4 m long, 2.1 m across the stern, gunwale at 1.02 m, cabin roof at 2.15 m. Bow is -Z. Cleats on the gunwales.
climbNote: The hull is a solid prop. Not a cling wall.
vaultNote: Gunwale is about 1.0 m. Not a vault rail.

name: Cabin
blurb: Log cabin 4.6 x 3.6 m, walls 2.15 m, ridge at 3.45 m, porch on +Z. The door is a closed frame-and-panel in the log opening.
climbNote: Log walls are cling. Door is closed. Roof slopes are landings.
vaultNote: Porch rail is 0.95 m above the porch deck (deck at 0.25 m, rail top at 1.20 m).

name: Boathouse
blurb: Boathouse 6.4 m wide, 4.4 m deep, walls 2.7 m, ridge at 4.15 m. The +Z side is an open slip, 2.4 m wide.
climbNote: Side and back walls are cling. The slip opening on +Z is empty. Roof slopes are landings.
vaultNote: No rail. Wall top is 2.7 m.

name: Bollard
blurb: Steel bollard, 0.95 m tall, 16 cm across the barrel, rounded cap.
climbNote: Too narrow to cling.
vaultNote: Round 0.95 m cap is not a vault rail. Treat it as a blocker.

name: Brick_Corner
blurb: Outside corner. Legs run to +X and +Z and are 2.0 m. Exterior faces are -X and -Z. A Brick_Wall end meets a leg end.
climbNote: Both exterior faces (-X and -Z) are cling. Interior corner is solid too.
vaultNote: No rail.

name: Brick_Door
blurb: 4.00 x 3.20 m bay with a closed 1.00 x 2.15 m door and a 0.12 m step. Exterior is +Z.
climbNote: Piers are cling. The door is closed and collides. Exterior is +Z.
vaultNote: Step is 0.12 m. Not a vault.

name: Brick_Parapet
blurb: 4.00 m parapet, 0.50 m tall, coping overhangs 3 cm. Stack on a wall (base is the pivot).
climbNote: Short cling face, 0.50 m. Useful as a roof edge, not a full wall.
vaultNote: Coping is 0.50 m above its own base. Vault only if the roof you stand on makes the coping fall in the 0.90–1.05 band.

name: Brick_Wall
blurb: 4.00 x 3.20 x 0.30 m brick bay. Exterior is +Z. A door and a window sit in 10 cm brick reveals, with one stone lintel and a stone sill. Butt the ends to Brick_Corner.
climbNote: Both broad faces are cling panels. Exterior is +Z. Climb_Wall is still the solid 0.30 m wall, so the 10 cm door recess does not change the cling surface.
vaultNote: No rail. The cornice is at 3.2 m.

name: Brick_Window
blurb: 4.00 x 3.20 m bay. Window opening 1.16 x 1.45 m, sill at 0.95 m. Glass is solid.
climbNote: Piers, sill, and header are cling. The opening is glass, not a hole. Exterior is +Z.
vaultNote: Sill is 0.95 m but only 0.30 m deep. Not a vault rail.

name: Buoy
blurb: Can buoy, 1.85 m tall. Ballast bulb, red cylindrical body with a white band, and a cage with a light. Pivot is the base.
climbNote: Round. Not a cling.
vaultNote: No rail.

name: BusShelter
blurb: 3.4 m shelter, open on -Z. Roof at 2.45 m, glass back and one side, bench inside.
climbNote: Glass and posts. The roof is a landing. Posts are 8 cm, not a cling wall.
vaultNote: Roof edge is 2.45 m. Too high to vault from the ground; it is a landing.

name: ChainFence
blurb: Chain-link panel 2.0 m wide, 1.8 m tall, posts 6 cm. Fabric is a welded diamond grid.
climbNote: The mesh is climbable in the loose sense, but the collider is the posts, rails, and a fabric slab the thickness of the wire.
vaultNote: Top rail is 1.80 m. Too high to vault from flat ground.

name: ChainGate
blurb: Gate leaf 1.20 m wide, 1.80 m tall. Hinge on -X, latch on +X. Pair it with ChainFence.
climbNote: Same wire slab as the fence panel, inset to the leaf.
vaultNote: Top is 1.80 m.

name: Cleat
blurb: Cast cleat, 26 cm across the horns, 11 cm tall. Sits on a deck; pivot is the base.
climbNote: Too small to cling.
vaultNote: Not a rail.

name: TrafficCone
blurb: Traffic cone 0.72 m tall, 0.36 m base.
climbNote: Not a cling.
vaultNote: Too light and short. Not a vault.

name: Container_20
blurb: 20-foot container, rust-red enamel. 6.06 x 2.44 x 2.59 m. Trapezoid corrugation, corner castings with oval holes, four locking bars on the +Z doors.
climbNote: Long sides are cling. Door bars are on +Z. Collider is inside the wall plate.
vaultNote: No rail. Roof is a landing at 2.59 m.

name: Container_40
blurb: 40-foot container, blue enamel. 12.19 x 2.44 x 2.59 m. Same trapezoid corrugation, oval-hole castings, and door bars as the 20-foot box.
climbNote: Long sides are cling. Door bars are on +Z. Collider is inside the wall plate.
vaultNote: No rail. Roof is a landing at 2.59 m.

name: Court
blurb: Street full court, 22 m by 12 m. One decal carries the FIBA paint scaled to the slab: boundary, center line, center circle, and at each end a lane, free-throw circle, restricted arc, and a 3-point arc that meets the corner lines. Lines are 5 cm. No collider on the paint.
climbNote: Flat slab, 0.12 m thick.
vaultNote: No rail. Place each Hoop pole 1.2 m behind the end line, rim toward center court.

name: CourtFence
blurb: Perimeter for the 22 x 12 m court. Same pivot as Court. Baselines 3.05 m, sidelines 1.80 m, closed gate on +X.
climbNote: Posts, rails, and a wire-thick fabric slab. The diamonds are not a passage. The gate is closed.
vaultNote: Sideline top is 1.80 m and the baselines are 3.05 m. Too high to vault from the court.

name: HarborCrane
blurb: Steel jib crane. 1.6 m base, tubular mast to 4.7 m, cab, and a level jib reaching about 4 m toward +Z. Counterweight on -Z.
climbNote: The mast is a 0.28 m tube, not a cling wall.
vaultNote: No rail. The jib is overhead.

name: Crate
blurb: Wood crate, 0.80 m cube. Slats sit on corner posts. Gaps are about 2 cm and are not a way through.
climbNote: A crate this size is a blocker, not a cling wall.
vaultNote: Top is 0.80 m. Under vault height, and the lid is the whole top.

name: Dock_Corner
blurb: L dock corner inside a 4 m square. Legs run toward +X and +Z from the inner corner. Deck top is 0.62 m, matching Dock_Straight.
climbNote: Walk the deck. The inner corner is open water, not a collider. Pivot is the center of the 4 m square, not the pile centroid.
vaultNote: No rail.

name: DockRamp
blurb: Ramp 4.0 x 2.0 m. Deck falls from 0.62 m at -Z to 0.05 m at +Z. Matches Dock_Straight.
climbNote: Walk the planks. Not a cling wall. Pivot is the center of the ramp, not the pile centroid.
vaultNote: The high end is 0.62 m. Under the vault band.

name: Dock_Straight
blurb: Dock module 6.0 m long and 3.0 m wide. Deck top is 0.62 m. Cleats on both sides, a rope coil, and a line between the near cleats. Butt the next module on the Z ends (center to center 6.0 m).
climbNote: Deck is a walk surface. Pilings are round, not cling panels.
vaultNote: No rail on this module. Deck height is 0.62 m, under a vault.

name: Dumpster
blurb: Front-load dumpster 2.20 x 1.20 m, 1.35 m tall. Lids closed. Fork pockets on the sides.
climbNote: Side walls are short cling faces, 1.2 m. Lids are a landing.
vaultNote: Lid top is 1.35 m. High for a ground vault; the side rail is not at 1.05.

name: ElectricalBox
blurb: Pad-mount cabinet 0.90 m wide, 1.15 m tall, 0.40 m deep, on a 1.15 m pad.
climbNote: Cabinet face is flat but only 1.15 m and 0.40 m deep. Not a cling wall.
vaultNote: Too shallow to vault.

name: FireEscape
blurb: Ladder and a 1.30 m platform at 3.05 m. Rail is 1.05 m above the deck. Place -Z against a wall.
climbNote: Ladder rails and rungs are Climb_*. They run from 0.20 m to the deck.
vaultNote: Vault_Rail is the platform handrail. Top of rail is 1.05 m above the deck (world y = 4.10).

name: FireHydrant
blurb: Dry-barrel hydrant, 0.76 m to the operating nut. Hose nozzles, pumper cap, chains, and flange bolts.
climbNote: Round barrel under 0.8 m. Not a cling wall.
vaultNote: Too short and too narrow to vault.

name: Fountain
blurb: Pedestal drinking fountain, 1.05 m to the bubbler, round basin.
climbNote: Not a cling.
vaultNote: Too narrow.

name: Garage
blurb: Single garage 3.6 m wide, 6.2 m deep, door 2.4 x 2.15 m on +Z. Ridge at 3.6 m.
climbNote: Side walls are cling. The overhead door is closed.
vaultNote: No rail.

name: GasCanopy
blurb: Fuel canopy 9.0 x 6.8 m, roof at 3.50 m with a fascia, two pumps and bollards. MART shop on -Z, price sign on +X, ICE machine beside the shop. FUEL sign faces +Z.
climbNote: Columns are 22 cm. The shop walls are cling.
vaultNote: No rail. The roof is at 3.50 m. Shop wall top is 3.15 m.

name: Gazebo
blurb: Hexagonal gazebo, about 4.4 m across the posts. Deck is 0.32 m with vertical skirt boards. Six posts on the deck corners, roof corners on the same rays with a 0.32 m overhang. Every side except the entry has a top rail, a bottom rail, and even balusters. One open side with a step. Top rail is 0.95 m above the deck. The square shelter is Pavilion.
climbNote: Posts are 12 cm. Not a cling wall. The roof is a landing.
vaultNote: Rail center is 0.95 m above the 0.32 m deck (y = 1.27). One side is the entry.

name: Gutter
blurb: 0.38 m wide, 4 m long. One concrete pan. The +X face butts the sidewalk curb; the -X face sits at the road edge. Top is 0.09 m, below the 0.12 m asphalt.
climbNote: A shallow pan. Not a cling face.
vaultNote: Under 0.15 m. Not a vault.

name: HarborRail
blurb: Railing bay 2.0 m long. Posts 5 cm, top rail at 1.05 m, mid rail, and a kick plate. Place end to end along X.
climbNote: Posts are 5 cm. Not a cling wall.
vaultNote: Vault_Rail is the top bar. Rail top is 1.05 m.

name: HarborWater
blurb: Water sheet 16 x 12 m, 2 cm thick. No collider. Set it at the waterline and let docks sit on their own pilings.
climbNote: Visual water. No collider, so it is not a floor and not a wall.
vaultNote: No collider.

name: Hoop
blurb: Regulation rim at 3.05 m, 2.49 m in front of the pole. Backboard face is 0.29 m behind the rim. Place the pole 1.2 m behind the baseline: south z=-12.2 yaw 0, north z=12.2 yaw 180, so the rim sits on the restricted-area center (z=±9.71). 1.80 x 1.05 m backboard, net, pole pad, and base plate. Rim faces +Z.
climbNote: Pole is 12 cm under the pad. Not a cling wall.
vaultNote: No rail. The rim is 3.05 m.

name: House
blurb: Siding house. Body 7.2 x 5.4 m, walls 2.75 m, ridge 4.35 m, porch on +Z at 0.30 m.
climbNote: Siding walls are cling. Windows are glass. Porch is open on +Z.
vaultNote: Porch rail is 0.95 m above the porch deck (deck y = 0.30, rail top y = 1.25).

name: House_Gable
blurb: Gable house. Body 7.6 x 6.8 m, walls 2.8 m, ridge about 4.6 m. Porch, steps, paneled door, trimmed windows, eave gutters, and a chimney. Porch faces +Z.
climbNote: Siding walls are cling. Windows are glass. The porch is open on +Z.
vaultNote: Porch rail is 0.95 m above the porch deck.

name: House_Hip
blurb: Hip-roof house. Body 8.4 x 7.2 m, walls 2.9 m, hip about 4.5 m. Porch, steps, paneled door, trimmed windows, gutters on the eaves, and a chimney. Porch faces +Z.
climbNote: Siding walls are cling. Windows are glass. The porch is open on +Z.
vaultNote: Porch rail is 0.95 m above the porch deck.

name: LaneArrow
blurb: White lane arrow, 2.0 m long. Visual only. Place it on a road top (y = 0.12), pointing +Z.
climbNote: Decal. The road slab under it is the collider.
vaultNote: No collider of its own, so it cannot become a lip.

name: LightPost_Single
blurb: Residential cobra head on a tapered steel pole with a 36 cm cast base. Lamp at 5.45 m.
climbNote: Round tapered pole, 11 cm at the base. Not a cling wall.
vaultNote: No vault edge. The arm is overhead.

name: LightPost_Double
blurb: Two cobra heads on one tapered pole. Lamps at 5.45 m, arms along +Z and -Z.
climbNote: Round tapered pole. Not a cling wall.
vaultNote: No vault edge. Both arms are overhead.

name: Lighthouse
blurb: Lighthouse, 10.2 m to the finial. Shaft tapers from 2.4 m to 1.64 m. Gallery rail is 1.05 m above the gallery deck.
climbNote: The shaft is round, not a cling panel. The door is a closed hatch on +X.
vaultNote: Gallery rail is 1.05 m above the gallery deck (deck y = 8.15, rail top y = 9.20).

name: Mailbox
blurb: Curbside mailbox. Post to 0.92 m, box 0.48 m long, flag on the +X side.
climbNote: Post is a 5 cm tube. Not a cling.
vaultNote: No vault edge.

name: Manhole
blurb: Round cover, 0.72 m across, 3 cm thick. Lift it onto a road surface.
climbNote: Flat ground cover.
vaultNote: Flush. Not a vault.

name: Mannequin
blurb: Scale figure, 1.80 m tall. Stands in the showcase so props can be judged against a player.
climbNote: Reference only.
vaultNote: Reference only.

name: Median_Planter
blurb: 4.0 x 1.05 m median, 0.40 m concrete coping closed on all four sides, soil and a clipped hedge.
climbNote: Too low to cling.
vaultNote: 0.40 m wall. Not a vault.

name: Mooring
blurb: Mooring finger 3.2 x 1.4 m, deck at 0.55 m, cleat and rope on the +X edge. No water collider.
climbNote: Walk the deck. Pilings are round and sit on -X, so the pivot stays the deck center.
vaultNote: Deck is 0.55 m. Under the vault band.

name: NewspaperBox
blurb: Newspaper honor box, 0.55 m wide, 0.95 m tall, glass front.
climbNote: Not a cling surface.
vaultNote: Too short to vault.

name: Pallet
blurb: 48 x 40 inch pallet (1.22 x 1.02 m), 0.14 m tall, three stringers.
climbNote: Not a wall.
vaultNote: 0.14 m. Not a vault.

name: ParkLamp
blurb: Path lamp, 3.20 m to the lantern cap. Four-post glass lantern with a bulb inside.
climbNote: Post is 9 cm. Not a cling wall.
vaultNote: No rail.

name: ParkSign
blurb: Entrance board, 1.80 m wide. The board center is at 1.70 m. Posts to 2.15 m.
climbNote: Posts are 8 cm. Not a cling wall.
vaultNote: No rail. The board is overhead of a 1.8 m player.

name: ParkingMeter
blurb: Single-space meter. Head 1.15–1.45 m, coin window, 5 cm post.
climbNote: Not a cling.
vaultNote: Too short to vault.

name: Pavilion
blurb: 4.6 m square pavilion. Deck at 0.15 m, rail at 0.95 m above the deck, eave at 2.55 m, peak at 3.90 m. No gazebo was in the repo; this is the park pavilion.
climbNote: Posts are 14 cm. Not a cling wall. The roof is a landing.
vaultNote: Vault_Rail runs between the posts, 0.95 m above the deck (rail top y = 1.10).

name: PicketFence
blurb: Picket bay, 2.0 m wide. Posts to 1.10 m, pointed pickets to 0.98 m, two rails on -Z.
climbNote: Pickets are 6 cm boards with gaps. Not a cling wall.
vaultNote: Post tops are 1.10 m. Not a vault rail.

name: PicnicTable
blurb: Picnic table 1.80 m long. Board top on two tapered A-frame trestles with a cross brace. Benches tie into the legs. Top at 0.76 m.
climbNote: Not a wall.
vaultNote: Top is 0.76 m, under the vault band. Benches are 0.45 m.

name: Piling
blurb: Fender pile, 3.20 m tall, 32 cm at the base tapering to 24 cm. Steel band and a rope wrap.
climbNote: Round timber. Not a cling wall. About 1.4 m of the shaft is below the pivot, in the water.
vaultNote: No rail. The head is 3.2 m, too high to vault from the dock.

name: Planter
blurb: 0.90 m square planter, 0.48 m tall, soil and a shrub. Walls are hollow.
climbNote: Too low.
vaultNote: 0.48 m. Not a vault.

name: Playground
blurb: Play set about 7.4 x 4.8 m. A-frame swings with two chains per red belt seat and a cream rim. Slide with rails and a curled lip, square posts to the mulch, guard panels, and blue stairs. Spring rider seat is about 0.6 m. Climbing dome is a geodesic of bars. Wood-chip patch inside a rubber border. Pivot is the pad center.
climbNote: Bars and posts are too small to cling. Not a wall.
vaultNote: The deck panels are a guard, not a 0.90 m vault. The rider seat is about 0.6 m.

name: PondEdge
blurb: 4 m pond coping. Stone lip faces -Z (the water). Soil bank is on +Z. Top of the lip is 0.22 m.
climbNote: The lip is 0.22 m. Not a cling wall.
vaultNote: No rail.

name: Quay_Edge
blurb: Concrete quay, 18 m long, apron 8.2 m deep, deck at 0.90 m. The water face is a vertical wall from about 1.2 m below the pivot up to the deck, with edge stone, four bollards, a ladder, and five fenders on -Z.
climbNote: The face is a wall. Too low and too thick to treat as a cling panel from the water.
vaultNote: Deck is 0.90 m. The bullnose is rounded, not a rail.

name: RaisedCrosswalk
blurb: Speed table, 6 m wide and 4 m long. Road top 0.12 m, crown 0.20 m, ramps 0.8 m. Stripes are paint.
climbNote: The crown is 8 cm above the road. Walk it. Not a cling wall.
vaultNote: 8 cm rise. Not a vault.

name: RecyclingBin
blurb: Street recycling bin, 0.52 m wide and 0.95 m to the lid. Blue body, white rim, green lid, and a drop slot.
climbNote: Not a cling surface.
vaultNote: Too short and narrow to vault.

name: Road_Cross
blurb: 6 x 6 m intersection. Attach Road_Straight to any edge, centered, 4 m further out.
climbNote: Flat intersection.
vaultNote: No curb on this tile.

name: Road_Crosswalk
blurb: 6 x 4 m straight with zebra bars across the lanes. Same socket as Road_Straight.
climbNote: Flat road. Paint has no collider.
vaultNote: No curb on this tile.

name: Road_Curve
blurb: 6 x 6 m corner. Asphalt enters on -Z and exits on +X. Inner sidewalk is the -X/+Z wedge.
climbNote: Curb at the sidewalk wedge is 0.15 m.
vaultNote: Curb is not a vault.

name: Road_Straight
blurb: 6 m wide (two 3 m lanes) by 4 m long. Top at 0.12 m. One continuous asphalt surface, one white edge line each side, dashed yellow center. Center the next tile 4 m along Z.
climbNote: Flat road.
vaultNote: No curb on this tile. Sidewalks carry the curb.

name: Road_T
blurb: 6 x 6 m. Through road along X, stem opens on +Z, curb closes -Z. Do not attach a straight to -Z.
climbNote: Curb face on -Z is 0.15 m. Too short to cling.
vaultNote: Curb is 0.15 m. Not a vault.

name: Roof_Parapet
blurb: 4.00 m parapet with a corbelled cornice and a concrete coping. 0.72 m tall. Stack on a wall.
climbNote: Short cling face. A roof edge, not a full wall.
vaultNote: Coping is 0.72 m above its own base.

name: RooftopAC
blurb: Rooftop condenser 1.30 x 0.90 m, 0.85 m tall, two fan grilles, sits on 8 cm rails.
climbNote: Not a wall.
vaultNote: Too bulky and low to vault. It is a rooftop obstacle.

name: RopeCoil
blurb: Three-turn rope coil, 48 cm across, 16 cm tall, with a loose tail. The center hole stays open.
climbNote: Soft prop. Colliders follow the rope, so the middle of the coil is empty.
vaultNote: Not a rail.

name: Seesaw
blurb: Seesaw, plank 2.8 m, seats at 0.72 m, fulcrum in the middle. Handles at each seat. Pivot is the base center.
climbNote: The fulcrum is too small to cling.
vaultNote: Seat is 0.72 m. Under the 0.90 m vault band.

name: ShopFront
blurb: 4.0 x 3.2 m shop bay. Framed glass, a door with a handle, and an awning that projects 1.1 m on +Z.
climbNote: Piers are cling. Glass and the door are solid. Awning is a landing.
vaultNote: Awning front edge is at 2.55 m. A landing, not a ground vault.

name: Shrub
blurb: Rounded shrub, 0.90 m tall, 1.05 m across.
climbNote: Not a cling.
vaultNote: Not a vault.

name: Sidewalk
blurb: 2 m wide, 4 m long, top at 0.27 m. Curb face is -X. Butt that face to the road edge (x = ±3 m).
climbNote: Curb face is 0.27 m tall from the pivot, 0.15 m above the road. Not a cling wall.
vaultNote: Curb is 0.15 m above the road. Not a vault.

name: Sign_Stop
blurb: STOP sign. Octagon 0.75 m across, bottom of the sign at 1.52 m.
climbNote: Sign pole is a 4.5 cm tube. Not a cling wall.
vaultNote: No rail at vault height. The sign face is overhead.

name: Sign_Street
blurb: Street blade 'MAPLE ST' at 2.55 m. Pole is 3.0 m, 6 cm tube.
climbNote: Pole is a 6 cm tube. Not a cling wall.
vaultNote: Blade is overhead. No vault rail.

name: StopBar
blurb: Stop bar 6.0 m across and 0.40 m deep. Visual only. Place it on a road top (y = 0.12).
climbNote: Decal. The road slab under it is the collider.
vaultNote: No collider of its own, so it cannot become a lip.

name: Store_Corner
blurb: Corner shop, 8.0 x 7.2 m, two stories to a 6.4 m parapet. Glazed MARKET shopfronts on +Z and +X: kickplate, mullions, a recessed door with a transom, sign band, brick string course, and a sloped awning. Alley face is -Z.
climbNote: The four walls are cling. Glass is solid. The roof is a parapet, not a rail.
vaultNote: No ground-height rail. The parapet is on the roof.

name: Store_Diner
blurb: Diner, 10.0 x 7.0 m, walls 4.6 m under a parapet. Cream body, a long mullioned DINER front with a red rail, recessed door, sign band, brick string course, and a sloped red awning. Alley face is -Z.
climbNote: The four walls are cling. Glass is solid. The roof is a parapet, not a rail.
vaultNote: No ground-height rail. The parapet is on the roof.

name: Store_Laundromat
blurb: Laundromat, 9.2 x 6.8 m, walls 4.8 m under a parapet. White body, narrow WASH bays, a high kickplate, recessed door, teal sign and sloped awning, brick string course. Alley face is -Z.
climbNote: The four walls are cling. Glass is solid. The roof is a parapet, not a rail.
vaultNote: No ground-height rail. The parapet is on the roof.

name: Storefront_Glass
blurb: 4.00 x 3.20 m ground-floor bay. Inset glass, mullions, and a framed door with a handle. Exterior is +Z. No awning.
climbNote: Piers are cling. Glass and the door are solid. Exterior is +Z.
vaultNote: No rail. The head is at 3.2 m.

name: StormDrain
blurb: Curb grate 0.70 x 0.40 m, 4 cm thick. Bars leave 3 cm slots. Walkable envelope.
climbNote: Flat grate.
vaultNote: Flush. Not a vault.

name: TrafficLight
blurb: Three-section signal at 4.6 m on a mast arm over a 4.2 m pole.
climbNote: Pole is round and 14 cm. Not a cling wall.
vaultNote: No rail at vault height.

name: TrashCan_Lidded
blurb: City trash can, about 0.92 m. Dark green slats, hoops, and flap, black liner, shallow lid.
climbNote: Not a cling surface.
vaultNote: Too narrow to vault.

name: TrashCan_Slat
blurb: Open-top public can, 0.92 m tall, 0.50 m across the slats.
climbNote: Not a cling surface.
vaultNote: 0.92 m rim is narrow and round. Not a vault rail.

name: Tree
blurb: Oak. Tapered trunk to about 2.2 m, forked limbs, and overlapping green clusters. Canopy about 4.0 m tall.
climbNote: Trunk is round, about 0.28 m at the flare. Not a flat cling wall.
vaultNote: No rail. The canopy is visual; the trunk is the blocker.

name: Tree_Grate
blurb: Street tree in a 1.20 m steel grate. Trunk about 2.4 m to the forks, canopy about 3.4 m. The grate opening clears the flare.
climbNote: Trunk is round, about 0.22 m at the flare. Not a flat cling wall.
vaultNote: No rail. The grate is a sidewalk skin. The trunk is the blocker.

name: Tree_Maple
blurb: Maple. Slimmer trunk than the oak, upright forks, olive and deep-green clusters.
climbNote: Trunk is round. Not a flat cling wall.
vaultNote: No rail. The canopy is visual; the trunk is the blocker.

name: Tree_Palm
